Subject: Benchmark evidence bundle and proposed demo cutover for MAP

Hi Helen —

Thanks again for the time today. Per our MAP milestones, attached is the initial evidence bundle that maps to the acceptance criteria in section 2 of the MAP (latency, throughput/QPS, TTFT under warm cache, and concurrency at target RPS). Highlights below:

- Key metrics (CSV): novastream_latency_qps_20260814.csv — contains the single-run summary and the three peak concurrency passes.
- Exec brief: exec_brief_benchmark_v2.pptx — one-page summary + appendix with raw charts.
- TTFT summary: ttft_concurrency_summary.xlsx — TTFT at 0.5/1/2/4/8 concurrent sessions with expected P95/P99.

Quick notes on methodology:
- Tests run against your subset model (redwood-v3-small-quant) pinned to the same container hash used in staging.
- Traffic profile: ramp from 10qps to 250qps over 20 minutes (see CSV).
- Cache state: warm prefix cache for TTFT runs; cold-run numbers are in the appendix.

Proposed next steps to keep the MAP timeline tight:
1) You and procurement confirm data room access (we shared a folder link below).
2) We schedule a 30-minute exec readout (slides + live dashboard) the week of Aug 17.
3) Live demo / cutover dry-run on Aug 20 (no traffic to production) — we’ll coordinate a short blast from our harness.

If that aligns with you, I’ll confirm invites and include a short runbook for the dry-run.

Thanks —
Lauren Bishop
Sr. Account Lead, Redwood Inference
